verdict.rationale: Luma documents exporting generated work in an open, industry-standard format: native 16-bit EXR frames in ACES2065-1 that composite in Resolve or Nuke. That covers getting individual generated assets out in open formats. Nothing in the evidence shows a bulk account-level export of all user data (projects, prompts, references, history) or a documented exit or deletion path. missing for 10: bulk export of all account data, export of prompts/projects/metadata in open formats, documented account deletion/offboarding, independent corroboration.
